verdict.rationale: Unreal Engine's license page lists 'Access to the source code' and 'All platforms & features'. The docs show the engine and editor being compiled and run on the user's own machine with Visual Studio or Xcode, cooked from the command line, and even hosting a local Remote Control web server, so the core product runs entirely on user-controlled infrastructure. Community comments confirm the source code is included, though the probe shows source access is gated behind a EULA and account rather than being openly public. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on building or self-hosting the engine from source, ungated (non-EULA/account) source access, and hands-on corroboration of a self-built deployment.
